Open verifier disagreements

Every ARC task with a generator was drawn from 150 times and checked against the verifier the pipeline actually selects. Scanned 600 tasks (400 ARC-AGI-1 + 200 validated ARC-AGI-2). 13 still disagree with their generator; 22 more verify cleanly but have a flaky generator. White outlines mark differing cells.

Eleven verifiers were fixed in this sweep and are not listed below: a64e4611, e6721834, ddf7fa4f, d8c310e9, 3906de3d, a644e277, 7ee1c6ea, 447fd412, 83302e8f, 8efcae92, 97a05b5b. If any of them appears here it is flagged as a REGRESSION. 0e206a2e and 50846271 are known-ambiguous and allowlisted (see framework/tasks/pair_guard.py); their mismatches are expected.
